tips.text: Fill your daily standing cap with conservation; one or two perfect Stover or Kubrodon captures usually do it.
Bring Equinox, Ivara or Loki, a tranquilizer rifle and an echo lure for conservation.
Mine gems at Deck 13 with a Resourceful Retriever companion and sell them to Smokefinger for standing.
Kill the Exploiter Orb for a day's worth of standing in gems plus a Toroid; it needs the Thermia fractures sealed and an Archwing.
Expect the climb to Old Mate to be the whole cost; the parts are a short afternoon after it.
